scope: Synthetic benchmark of existing authoring pipeline; non-blind model-assisted rubric review, not human user ratings. System One shadow only, not a production semantic gate.

baseline.model: Local Codex CLI default; current production runner does not expose resolved model ID or token usage.

summary.caveat: Curated synthetic cases, not population accuracy. Lexical signals require semantic review. Completion and graph readiness do not establish useful answers.

reviewAggregate.headline: Extraction/correction was strong in these synthetic cases. Visible-first question selection was the main weakness.

shadowComparison.caveat: This is a small, non-blind, scripted sample. The shadow model ranks existing candidates only; it does not prove generated-question quality or user satisfaction.
